title: Three Years and One Short Plan
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：pub　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pub 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the planner ① openned the pub that no citizen in the district would have measured, and he said the openning was the whole of the year. The ② pub, meaning the inn itself and not the plan, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; a pub, he said, is the only thing in a district that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ pub in that district had the same short plan beside it, and the ④ pub at the far square, meaning the plot they kept for the children to measure and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pub, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the planner said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pub was the whole of the matter, meaning the company and not the inn. The ⑥ pub, meaning the company and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; pub, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both an inn and a company. He said the company is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ pub had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short plan. The ⑧ pub of the whole thing, the planner wrote in March, was one district and three years of measuring; pub, he said, is either the plot at the far square or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pub I remember is the inn measured in the report, which closed in 1996 and is still measured as the quietest in the district. A ⑩ pub, my mother said in 1998, is the only inn that improves by being measured; every pub, she said, is a company that has agreed to look like an inn. She said the company was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 酒馆；小酒店（指街区里每一家旁边的那一家）
B. n. 酒馆；小酒店（指那家酒馆本身，与薄薄的图纸相对）
C. 固定搭配：open the pub 开这一家酒馆
D. n. 酒馆；小酒店（指留给孩子们丈量的那一块）
E. n. 酒馆之事（抽象总称，指一处街区的酒馆之事）
F. n. 酒馆；小酒店（指规划报告里写到、被测量的那一家）
G. n. 酒馆、闲聚（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 闲聚（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: openned the pub that no citizen in the district would have measured
The pub, meaning the inn itself and not the plan
the pub at the far square
the pub was the whole of the matter
the pub had become a line in a report
The pub of the whole thing
A pub, my mother said in 1998

answers.why: open the pub 意为“开这一家酒馆”，1989 年那位规划员把街区里没有一位市民肯测量的一家酒馆做了一遍。
pub 意为“酒馆；小酒店”，指那家酒馆本身而不是薄薄的图纸，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被测量。
pub 意为“酒馆；小酒店”，指街区里每一家旁边的那一家，每一家旁边都有同一张薄薄的图纸。
pub 意为“酒馆；小酒店”，指最远那处广场的留给孩子们丈量的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pub 意为“酒馆、闲聚”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这家闲聚就是那件事的全部。
pub 意为“闲聚”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那家酒馆，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pub 意为“酒馆；小酒店”，指规划报告里写到、被测量的那一家，到 1994 年这一家成了规划报告里的一行。
pub 意为“酒馆之事”，规划员三月写道，整件事的酒馆之事是一处街区和三个年份的测量。
pub 意为“酒馆；小酒店”，我记得的是规划报告里测量过的那一家，1996 年落成了，至今仍被说成街区里最安静的一家。
pub 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，酒馆是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的酒馆。
